feature_name: Component Library Enhancements and Testing Infrastructure
description: Enhance the component library with improved error handling, data visualization capabilities, and theming support while strengthening the testing infrastructure for state management and database interactions. This includes adding error boundaries for component failures, expanding charting components, and improving upload functionality.
functional_requirements: Implement error boundary components that gracefully handle and display component failures without crashing the entire application
Enhance data visualization components with additional chart types and configuration options for Cartesian coordinate systems
Improve file upload components with better error handling and progress tracking capabilities
Add theming support for UI components with customizable base styles and design tokens
Strengthen testing infrastructure for state management, client-side storage, and database model interactions
Update package dependencies and installation processes to support the new component features
